Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/openai__robosumo --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by.kind is 'model' and reviewed_by is null; the hardware backend was never run and is not claimed. The upstream clone has no LICENSE file, so the lock keeps the card's license_spdx NOASSERTION and license_class unknown. The upstream package needs gym, mujoco_py and MuJoCo; it was not importable where the gate ran, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic model of RoboSumo-Ant-vs-Ant-v0 (fake.py) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The deployed fake is fidelity level F0 (kinematic, no force or contact model); the upstream MuJoCo simulator would be F1, but it was not run. NOT COVERED: the other eight registered variants (Bug/Spider pairings) are not served; rendering and cap.world.render.v1 are not bound; the real per-agent observation is 120 values (15 qpos + 14 qvel + 78 contact-force values from 13 bodies + 7 opponent torso qpos + 6 opponent torso forces, agents.py:190-212) while the fake returns three position values per agent; the upstream per-agent reward tuple (sumo.py:188-192) is exposed as the scalar sum of the two reduced rewards with the per-agent values only in info['rewards']; the move_to_opp and push_opp shaping terms (sumo.py:168-184) are not modelled. The action space is a named Dict of the two per-agent Box spaces instead of the upstream Tuple (sumo.py:112-114) so the gymnasium bridge can derive the real per-motor ctrlrange limits; the fake also checks the bounds, but the runtime refusal is authoritative. The catalogue ticks range is enforced as schema, not as a declared Limit, so the envelope probes are the per-motor action bounds and the two action out_of_envelope fixtures. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x2 for reset and step (they come from the external gym.Env base, not defined by SumoEnv/MujocoEnv in the clone), and G8.NO_UNIT x5 for bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks, action.ant0[*], action.ant1[*]). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
